description: SCOPE INCOMPLETE: the spec lists `akt-treasury.sh` as a NEW in-scope file (spec lines 32, 53; INV-5 says mint/swap 'live only in akt-treasury.sh'), but that file DOES NOT EXIST in the tree (Glob **/akt-treasury.sh -> no files found). INV-5's positive half ('funding lives in akt-treasury.sh') is therefore unverifiable — only the negative half (deploy-akash.sh contains no mint/swap) is checked by the oracle (test-deploy-akash.sh:24). evidence.snippet: `/Users/operator/anicca/skills/self/spawn/scripts/akt-treasury.sh`  (NEW: off-path AKT/ACT top-up)  ... INV-5 ... those live only in akt-treasury.sh

correctFix: Implement akt-treasury.sh and add it to the oracle, OR descope it from B1 explicitly. Until it exists INV-5 cannot be claimed satisfied as written.
